newsitem.title: GERMANY: POLL - Analysts see no change to Bundesbank repo.
newsitem.headline: POLL - Analysts see no change to Bundesbank repo.

text.p: The Bundesbank will announce on Tuesday terms for its next securities repurchase agreement or repo. The central bank has maintained a fixed, three percent repo since August 1996.
Eight analysts were polled on Monday and said unanimously that a further deal would be set at this rate on Tuesday.
Robert Prior, James Capel yes no
Craig Shute, Bear Stearns yes no
Gernot Nerb, Salomon Brothers yes no
Timo Klein, MMS International yes no
David Brickman, Yamaichi Int'l yes no
Joerg Kraemer, Merrill Lynch yes no
Ian Ford, MCM YieldWatch yes no
